component.name: Luxel
component.summary: Control LIFX smart bulbs and SmartLife devices from your desktop

description.p: Luxel discovers LIFX smart bulbs on your local network and lets you switch them on and off, dim them, tune white color temperature, and set colors — all without a phone or cloud account. Group lights by room, control whole rooms or the whole house at once, and save scenes you can restore with one click.
Optionally, add a LIFX Cloud personal access token to control lights remotely when local discovery is unavailable.

Inline slide-down color controls for rooms, a device-details popover (MAC, IP, product, firmware, data points), connection/vendor subtitles with an Interface setting, mesh-gradient room color chips, and sizing polish.

SmartLife/Tuya smart plug support with fully local control, a guided setup wizard that fetches device keys from the Tuya cloud and finds devices on the network, a Settings redesign, a HIG-aligned menu with a keyboard shortcuts dialog, and a refreshed icon.
Scenes can now be exported to a file and imported back.
New app icon, and installs now update automatically from Luxel's own Flatpak repository.
Initial release: local LAN control, rooms, scenes, color wheel, and optional LIFX Cloud support.
